Cave Creek and Carefree pickups, and the drive home

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Cave Creek and Carefree sit at the top of the metro, past the North Scottsdale edge, and they are a different kind of job: long desert roads, a saloon strip in Historic Cave Creek that nobody should drive home from, and desert resort guests who want the same vehicle for the whole stay.

How we work in Cave Creek

The drive up here is the whole argument for a chauffeur. Historic Cave Creek is a compact strip of bars and restaurants with a dark, winding drive back toward the Valley at the end of the night. Groups book one vehicle that waits through the evening rather than gambling on a ride that will not come this far out at closing time.

Where we pick up in Cave Creek

We pick up along the Historic Cave Creek saloon strip, across Carefree, and at the desert resorts on both sides of the town line. The Pinnacle Peak corridor is a short run south, so North Scottsdale groups often start or finish here.

Which airport serves Cave Creek

  • PHX: Phoenix Sky Harbor International
  • SCF: Scottsdale Airport
  • AZA: Phoenix-Mesa Gateway

Neighborhoods we cover in Cave Creek

  • Cave Creek: Historic Cave Creek
  • Carefree: Carefree Town Center

Frequently asked questions

Will a vehicle come this far north?

Yes. Cave Creek and Carefree are inside the normal service area, at the same published hourly rates as the rest of the metro. Late pickups from the Historic Cave Creek strip are routine work for us.

Can you hold the vehicle through a night out on the strip?

Yes — that is the usual booking here. The vehicle is yours for the hours you reserve, so it waits between stops and takes the group home at the end rather than leaving you to find a ride at closing.

Do you serve the Carefree and Cave Creek resorts?

Yes. Resort guests commonly hold one vehicle across a stay for dinners, golf and the airport run, which is cheaper than booking each leg separately.

How long is the run to the airports?

Cave Creek and Carefree are the far north of the service area, so airport runs are longer than a central pickup. Give the reservations team your flight and they will set the pickup time against it.
